title: ci(sdui): retire the per-package SDUI manifest records; CI's regeneration holds freshness (#26137 PR B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAqVfFyhsxKuFcEP9YTBj25)_

Closes #26137 (PR B of two: PR A #26315 put the regeneration in CI; this retires the per-package records it replaces). Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`).
Part of objectstack#25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 删掉 `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` 下 26 个按包记录的源码摘要,以及 `check-sdui-manifest` 里比对这些摘要的第 3 项检查。清单是否新鲜,现在只由 #26315 加的 CI 步骤判定:`Build & E2E UI` 重新生成 `sdui.manifest.json` 并逐字节比较,PR 上和合并队列的合并树上都跑。lint 里的检查保留存在性、形状和 sha256 防篡改。`AGENTS.md` 里仍在讲已退役 objectui 钉的那段改为现状(行数不变)。
- **为什么改:** 摘要记录是在 CI 不能重新生成清单时的替代品。它让两个改同一个 registry 包的 ui PR 在记录文件上冲突,哪怕谁都没改清单(`i18n` 最热,12 个开着的 ui PR 里有 5 个碰它)。本 PR 自己 rebase 到 `main` 时就撞上 7 个这样的冲突,而清单一个字节都没变。CI 重新生成后,PR 只在清单真的变了时冲突。
- **哪些原来能合的现在会被拒:** 没有。仍带 `inTree.registryRecords` 的旧记录会被拒,提示重新生成。
- **哪些原来被拒的现在能合:** 只改 registry 源码、不改清单的 PR 不用再提交记录文件。清单过期仍由 `Build & E2E UI` 拒绝,而且它看得见解析器、registry 引用的 `@objectstack` 包和两个排队 PR 合起来的效果,摘要看不见这些。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 CI、脚本和文档,不发布任何包,清单字节不变。在本 PR 之前开的分支如果改过某个记录文件,rebase 时会遇到"修改/删除"冲突,删掉该文件即可。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** Tier H,需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 审批。

## 席位核对

(left for the dispatch seat)

## Why

`check-sdui-manifest` held freshness with a source digest per registry package, recorded one line per package under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` (#26051). The digests existed because a PR author could not afford to regenerate the manifest on every push. They cost two things (#26137):

1. **Conflicts on records, not on the contract.** Two PRs that touched the same registry package's `src/` conflicted on that package's record even when neither changed `sdui.manifest.json`.
2. **A blind spot.** No digest saw `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, the `@objectstack` packages the registry imports, or two queued PRs whose effect on the manifest only shows together.

#26315 made CI regenerate the manifest in `Build & E2E UI` and compare it with the committed bytes, on `pull_request` and on the merge queue's combined tree. It is green on `main`: the push run on `4ddf6df61` passed 50 of 53 check runs with 3 skipped and none failed, and `Build & E2E UI` ran the new step. The digests now only produce the conflicts. Rebasing this PR onto `main` hit seven of them: `components`, `core`, `i18n`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid`, `react` and `types` had been re-recorded since, and the manifest's bytes had not moved.

## What changes

### `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`

- **Check 3 in-tree is gone.** `registrySourceDigests`, `readRegistryRecords`, `registryRecordPath`, `registryRecordLine`, `REGISTRY_RECORDS` and the gate's copy of `REGISTRY_MODULES` go with it.
- **The in-tree leg keeps** the artefact's presence and shape, the sha256 and component count against the record, and the `inTree` block (`modulesRoot`, `objectuiWorkspaceVersion`).
- **A record that still carries `inTree.registryRecords` is RED** as a retired layout, the same way the single-digest fields from before #26051 already are. That catches a branch cut before this PR that regenerated with the old generator.
- **`READ_PATHS` and `ROOT_WATCH_HINTS`** drop `ui/packages/**` and the records directory. The gate reads neither now, so a registry package edit no longer derives it.
- **The success line** says what it checked and names the CI step for freshness.
- **The pin mode is untouched.**

### Self-test: 29 rows → 21

The nine digest rows go with the code they tested:

- a staged edit naming one package;
- an unstaged edit;
- tests and unreached packages;
- a new workspace edge;
- a new package;
- a removed package;
- a deleted record;
- an other-artefact record;
- a record out of its one-line form.

Two rows pin the new boundary, and each was ablated to show it bites:

| Row | Ablation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| a record from the per-package layout is RED with the in-tree command | drop `registryRecords` from the retired fields | row reds |
| a producer run whose artefact did not move leaves the record as it was (replaces "re-records only the package whose sources moved") | stamp today's `generatedAt` | row reds |
| same | re-read the `@object-ui/core` version instead of carrying it | row reds |

The carry row matters more now: the record is the one shared file left, so a producer that rewrote it on every run would make every pair of ui PRs conflict on it again.

`SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 29 → 21 matches the roster. The unused must-not-name column and the producer-list parity check (it existed only for the digest) are removed.

### `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`

- No digests, no refusal of unstaged registry bytes (that existed because the digest read the index), no per-package records.
- It no longer imports the gate, and drops `git-env.mjs`.
- The build, the enumeration, the record's carry rule and the pin mode are unchanged.
- The record's `//` note now names the CI step.

### The records and the record

- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` (26 files) is deleted.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` is regenerated. It loses `inTree.registryRecords` and takes the new note.
- `sdui.manifest.json` is **byte-identical** (sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`, 106 components), and `generatedAt` is carried.

### Readers

- `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: the comment, the real-build assertion and the record-only fixture name only the shared record.
- `lint.yml` and `ci.yml`: the step comments.
- `docs/releases-maintenance.md`: the manifest section, and the cut-rc step that said lint held freshness.

- `AGENTS.md` (the dispatch seat asked for it here): the manifest paragraph still described the retired objectui pin. It said to run `pnpm objectui:build`, that `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` reds until you regenerate, and that `objectui:bump` and `objectui:refresh` print the step, but no `objectui:*` script exists since the cutover. It now names the in-tree command and the CI step. It is line-neutral: 5 lines stay 5, each ≤ 118 bytes, the file stays at 1112 lines, and `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-governed-prose` pass.

`cut-rc.yml` and `release.yml` name only the tracked artefact, so they need no change.

### Widening or narrowing

**For freshness, this is a narrowing of the lint gate, covered by a wider check that is already required.** Every case the digests refused is a case where the committed manifest differs from what the tree generates, or a case where it does not:

- **The manifest differs:** a registry source change that moves the manifest, or a combination of PRs. `Build & E2E UI` refuses it on the PR or in the queue.
- **The manifest does not differ:** a source change that does not move it, or a new package or edge that adds no component. Refusing those was the conflict cost, not protection.

`Build & E2E UI` runs on `ui || ui_consumers`, and the registry's runtime closure is inside those filters (#26315's table), so no stale manifest that the digests caught reaches `main`.

## Merge order

- **#26343** (2g PR 2) re-records `components`, `core`, `plugin-dashboard` and `types` and deletes `sdui-parser.json` under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/`. Whichever lands second rebases:
  - If #26343 lands first, this PR takes modify/delete conflicts on those records, and `git rm` resolves them.
  - If this PR lands first, #26343 drops its record edits the same way.
  - Its one hunk in `scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (header lines 28–29) does not overlap this PR's hunks. It does not touch `sdui.manifest.json` or the record.
- **Open branches** that changed a file under `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/` get a modify/delete conflict on rebase. `git rm` the file, then re-run `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` if the PR changes the manifest.

## Verification

Head `15f5e2777`, on `main` `77a52cfe8`. 34 files, +198 / −687, one commit. 26 of the files are the deleted records. Tier H: `check-governed-merges --test` exits 3 for `ci.yml`, `lint.yml` and `AGENTS.md`, and 0 for the other five.

- **Regeneration:** on this head, `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` rebuilt the registry after `main` moved (467 s) and left `git status` clean. `sdui.manifest.json` was byte-identical, and the committed record is exactly what it writes ("left unchanged … its date and version are carried").
- **`check-sdui-manifest`:** `--self-test` 21 cases behave, and the production run is green: "present and intact (sha256 1f6e1ccb925a…, 106 components) … Not judged here: whether it is the manifest this tree generates."
- **Ablations:** the three in the table above, each red, each restored.
- **Before the rebase**, the same change stacked on PR A (`75d1ea668`, without the AGENTS.md paragraph) passed:
  - the derived sweep, 82 of 82 exit 0, with `--ran` reconciling 82 derived, 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN;
  - the push battery, 2164 cases pass, 0 fail, EXIT 0.
- **On this head**, the sweep and the battery are running and will be added here.
- **CI:** pending.
